item_summary: $120-160 portable 24,000mAh USB-C power bank with 100W output suitable for extending the battery life of productivity laptops
detailed_item_draft: Procure a high-capacity portable USB-C power bank featuring a nominal 24,000mAh (approx. 88Wh) cell configuration, compatible with TSA carry-on regulations. The unit must deliver up to 100W via USB-C Power Delivery (PD) 3.0/3.1 protocol, ensuring sufficient wattage for charging productivity laptops like MacBook Pro 16", Dell XPS 15, or HP ZBook during extended use. Target price range is $120-$160. Physical constraints include a lightweight design under 550g with dimensions suitable for easy portability. Essential features include a built-in intelligent digital display for battery state-of-charge accuracy, support for PPS (Programmable Power Supply) for efficient charging, and robust thermal management to prevent overheating at max output. Must include at least one 100W rated USB-C to USB-C cable. Build quality should prioritize scratch-resistant aluminum alloy or high-grade polycarbonate. Safety certifications (UL, CE, FCC) and a minimum 18-month warranty are required. The power bank should support simultaneous input/output charging (pass-through) and possess multi-protection safety circuits.
